items.docs: The latest locations endpoint returns information about the **resource's** latest location. It is a map from resourceId to latest location.

params.name: accuracy
params.description: All points returned will have an accuracy of at least the number given. If this parameter is not provided the default value is 100. To return all points use an empty string.

items.docs:
The Location history end point allows you to retrieve the location history for a resource.
The default limit is 100 results.

The location update endpoint allows one or more position updates to be provided indicating a resource's location.

The resource is determined by the Java Web Token provided. It is not possible for users other than the logged in user to update a resources position.

info.name: Locate resources with a set distance

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude (degrees).  This should be in decimal format, ie. "DDD.DDDD" not degrees and minutes.

params.name: lng
params.description: The longitude of the position (degrees).  This should be in decimal format, ie. "DDD.DDDD" not degrees and minutes.

params.name: distance
params.description: The distance (metres) to query for resources.  Note that the accuracy of the resources location is not considered when making this query.

params.name: start
params.description: Only consider points after this time.

params.name: end
params.description: Only consider points before this time.

params.name: accuracy
params.description: Ignores any points that have an accuracy greater than the number given. If this parameter is not provided the default value is 100. To return all points use an empty string.

items.docs: Locate all resources within a set distance of a specified location.
